deep_dive.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
deep_dive.abstract: Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level, an outer world-data-model flywheel continuously incorporates open-world corpus and leverages evolving model weaknesses to guide subsequent data construction and optimization iterations. At the data level, an inner flywheel couples open-world seeding and autocatalytic propagation. The former mines authentic workflows as seed tasks from instructional videos, and employs visual-semantic dual-path trajectory reconstruction; The latter transforms these seeds into reusable primitives for controllable synthesis of diverse, complex, and verifiable tasks. To enable efficient and reliable trajectory collection, we further introduce a feedback-guided snapshot-rollback retry mechanism in various real environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CUA-Master-27B achieves competitive performance across GUI-only and GUI-CLI hybrid benchmarks, scoring 80.2 on OSWorld Verified, 36.9 on OSWorld 2.0, 43.9 on WeaveBench, and 25.0 on Agents' Last Exam. Our framework also substantially improves the quality and efficiency of data synthesis, and exhibits continuous gains across recursive iterations.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: CUA-Master tackles limited diversity and reliability of computer-use agent interaction data with a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework that couples an open-world data flywheel with evolving model weaknesses.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 计算机使用智能体受限于交互数据的多样性、可控性与可靠性，且现有递归改进依赖自生成经验而收益递减。作者提出CUA-Master嵌套双环递归改进框架，外层以开放世界数据模型飞轮引导数据构建与优化迭代，内层飞轮耦合开放世界种子数据。该框架持续扩展智能体能力并缓解自我经验的局限。其贡献在于为通用计算机使用智能体的规模化训练与数据构建提供系统方案。
